text:
nina: Spotted a double-charge on a streaming toolcall when client retried after a KV eviction. Provisional tokens stayed open and retry produced a confirmed row so customer paid twice.

omar: Can you paste the minimal logs/headers? Need to see session vs client-trace.

nina: Logs: ```INFO 2026-03-24T02:11:02Z stream=s-11 provisional=80 kv_evicted=true reconnect=true
INFO 2026-03-24T02:11:04Z ledger:confirm request=r-11 tokens=160 origin=retry```
Headers: `x-session-id:ss-11`, `x-client-trace:c-77`.

lee: Sounds like we lack a stable join key across reconnects. client-trace rotates on reconnect so provisional->confirm join fails.

tara: Two short-term fixes: 1) emit an immutable origin_trace at session start and propagate it, 2) make confirm path merge overlapping provisional ranges if origin_trace absent.

omar: Prefer origin_trace (stateless). We must add a DB index for joins before turning on merge to avoid latency.

nina: Console UX: show linked provisional/confirm rows and a "possible duplicate" badge. Also emit telemetry: `provisional_orphan_ratio` per route to track rollout.

lee: Tests: unit for eviction+retry, integration for truncated toolcall + retry, and billing smoke on canary orgs.

tara: Rollout plan: add header in SDK behind flag, index migration (concurrent), enable merge behind FF, run reconcile sweep for affected tenants, then flip.

ops-bot: scheduled deploy: origin-trace-ff -> canary in 20m :gear:

nina: I'll file the RFC and open the reconcile ticket for the impacted tenant. Thanks all.
